purpose: Define a single, deterministic, two-line source header distinguishing direct module/API dependencies from direct library dependencies. Enable one-pass dependency collection for Build Tool and future CW code import.

scope.applies_to: Every code file outside Hardcore, including Core Modules, System Lib, System Modules, Expose transport modules, AIGM User Modules and User Modules.

source_header.location: At the beginning of the source file, before imports and executable declarations.
source_header.value_format: JSON array of strings; identifiers must match explicitly registered identities

deps.meaning: Only the dependencies on modules and Hardcore interfaces used directly by this file.

libs.meaning: Only libraries, including System Lib, used directly by this file.

declaration_rules: Both lines are always present, even when either or both lists are empty.
Only direct/immediate dependencies are declared; do not repeat indirect/transitive dependencies.
If a file uses a transitive dependency directly as well, declare that use explicitly.
deps and libs are separate and must not be interchanged.
Use stable dependency identifiers rather than filename/path inference.
Duplicate IDs or misclassified dependencies are errors.
No implicit authority or permission is granted by a declaration.

examples.name: Empty valid header
examples.meaning: Either or both arrays may be empty.

examples.name: REST also using CS directly
examples.meaning: Direct CS use is declared even though EXP itself requires CS.

dependency_graph.collection: Read each non-Hardcore source file once and extract both fields with file provenance. Build the dependency graph in memory.
dependency_graph.resolution: Resolve IDs from the dependency registry and validate source classification and allowed dependency classes.
dependency_graph.closure: Compute transitive dependency closure after source collection; derived edges are not copied into source headers.
dependency_graph.source_of_truth: The file header is the authority for declared code-level dependencies. Module manifest may include generated/validated dependency projections but must not duplicate independent, conflicting requires data.
dependency_graph.cw_import: CW importer may map direct typed edges with source-file provenance into StructureTree; it must mark closure edges derived rather than declared.

architectural_classification.core_modules: Optional modules distinct from System Lib.
architectural_classification.system_lib: Reusable library code, a separate class from Core Modules and System Modules.
architectural_classification.exp: EXP is optional System Lib, directly dependent on HC.CS.
architectural_classification.rest: REST is an optional Expose module requiring EXP; a consumer need not repeat EXP's HC.CS dependency.
